missing_and_unexpected_keys.explanation_of_missing_keys: encoder.embed_tokens.weight and decoder.embed_tokens.weight are aliases that point to shared.weight in memory. HuggingFace T5 saves shared.weight once and re-points encoder/decoder embeddings to it on load.

warning_analysis.warning_message: [transformers] The tied weights mapping and config for this model specifies to tie shared.weight to lm_head.weight, but both are present in the checkpoints with different values, so we will NOT tie them. You should update the config with tie_word_embeddings=False to silence this warning.
warning_analysis.root_cause_of_warning: In FLAN-T5 (T5 v1.1), lm_head.weight and shared.weight are untied with independent weights (max diff: 125.92). However, config.json had tie_word_embeddings=True (inherited from T5 v1.0 default). When tie_word_embeddings is True, older transformers (or manual tie_weights) overwrites lm_head.weight with shared.weight, destroying output projection and causing total collapse into repetitive multilingual tokens.
warning_analysis.required_config_fix: Set tie_word_embeddings=False in config.json to explicitly reflect that FLAN-T5 has an untied LM head.
